runs.question: How much will Eliquis 5 mg cost me with Medicare?
runs.reply: For a 30-day supply of Eliquis 5 mg tablets (60 tablets), the estimate across Massachusetts Medicare Part D plans is $0–$62.18 per month; the typical estimate is $47. Your cost may be higher before you meet your deductible, so check with your plan and call your pharmacy to confirm. The 2026 Medicare Part D yearly out-of-pocket cap is $2,100. CMS lists a 56% discount off Eliquis’s 2023 list price for its 2026 negotiated price; that discount is not your exact copay.
